items.title: Why CVS Health’s Tech Chief Says He's 'Allergic' to the 'Chief AI Officer' Title
items.summary: Tilak Mandadi, chief experience and technology officer at CVS Health, criticized the growing trend of appointing "Chief AI Officers," and explains what leaders should be focusing on instead.

items.title: How CVS Health Uses AI Simulations to Accelerate Research
items.summary: At the WSJ Leadership Institute's Tech Council Summit, CVS Health’s Sri Narasimhan breaks down how AI simulations are disrupting traditional market research.

items.title: CVS Stock Returned $24B In Cash: Why Did It Still Lag The Market?
items.summary: The health care giant showered its owners with cash, yet the stock spent years in the slow lane. Here’s the accounting of what that trade-off actually delivered.

items.title: How CVS Health is Recreating Human Behavior
items.summary: Joon Sung Park, chief executive of AI startup Simile, and Tilak Mandadi and Sri Narasimhan of CVS Health discuss the practical applications, accuracy and enterprise potential of AI-driven human behavior simulations.

items.title: Should You Buy UNH Stock Because Its Cash Runs Ahead Of Its Profit?
items.summary: UnitedHealth (UNH) has spent the past year repairing margins rather than chasing growth. The shares rebounded well ahead of any actual margin recovery: up about 38% over the past six months, though down about 6% over the past three, and still behind the S&P 500 over the past twelve months, 12.2% for the stock against 18.6% for the index. What argues for owning them now shows up in cash running ahead of reported profit.

items.title: Should You Buy CVS Stock on the Dip?
items.summary: CVS Health is looking more attractive -- and it sports an appealing dividend, too, recently yielding 2.8%.

items.title: Walgreens retreats as CVS quietly takes over suburban pharmacies
items.summary: CVS is picking up the overflow as Walgreens closes 1,200 stores and goes private.

items.title: The biggest threat to your retirement is based on a myth — it could rip through your nest egg and even ruin your health
items.summary: Older workers are forced to battle assumptions that they are slow learners and are baffled by technology.
